page.title: 完了・未完・いつでも

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、完了済みの already、未完・確認の yet、経験や範囲を尋ねる ever を中心に、and yet・hardly ever・ever since まで扱う。already は肯定文で「すでに」、yet は疑問文・否定文の文末で「もう／まだ」、ever は「これまでに・いつでも」を表す。
grammarPoints: already は完了・予想より早い成立を表す
yet は疑問文で「もう」、否定文で「まだ」を表し、通常文末に置く
ever は経験を尋ねる疑問文や最上級表現で使う
and yet は「それにもかかわらず」と逆接を示す
hardly ever は「ほとんど決して～ない」という低頻度を表す
ever since は過去の起点から現在までの継続を表す
現在完了と already・yet・ever の相性を理解する
visualEvidence: 完了箱に already、未完の空欄に not ... yet が置かれ、状態の違いが描かれている
疑問符付きの yet と経験タイムライン上の ever が別の位置で示されている
and yet の橋が逆向きの二つの内容をつなぎ、逆接を表している
hardly ever の頻度計がゼロ近く、ever since の矢印が過去から現在まで続いている
commonTraps: 肯定文の文末へ yet を置いて already の意味にする
否定文で already と yet を無差別に使う
ever を肯定の通常文で always の意味にする
hardly ever に not を重ねる
ever since の後ろを未来の起点にする
and yet を単なる時間の yet と誤解する

questions.prompt: The accounting team has ------- processed your refund, so it should appear soon.

choices.A: already
choices.C: ever

questions.translationJa: 経理チームはすでに返金処理を完了しているため、まもなく反映されるはずです。
questions.explanationJa: 肯定の現在完了で完了済みを示す already が適切です。

questions.prompt: Has the supplier sent the revised certificate -------?

choices.A: already not
choices.C: ever since

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は改訂証明書をもう送りましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 疑問文の文末で「もう」を表す yet を使います。

questions.prompt: The replacement key has not arrived -------.

choices.A: already
choices.C: yet

questions.translationJa: 交換用の鍵はまだ届いていません。
questions.explanationJa: 否定文の文末の yet は「まだ～ない」を表します。

questions.prompt: Have you ------- used the express check-in service at this hotel?

choices.A: already not
choices.C: and yet

questions.translationJa: このホテルの簡易チェックインサービスをこれまでに利用したことがありますか。
questions.explanationJa: 経験を尋ねる現在完了疑問文では ever が自然です。

questions.prompt: The device is compact, ------- it can process large files quickly.

choices.A: and yet
choices.C: ever since

questions.translationJa: その装置は小型ですが、それにもかかわらず大きなファイルを高速処理できます。
questions.explanationJa: 予想に反する二内容を and yet が結びます。

questions.prompt: The emergency generator ------- fails during monthly tests.

choices.A: does not hardly
choices.C: already

questions.translationJa: 非常用発電機が月例試験で故障することはほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: hardly ever は非常に低い頻度を表し、not は不要です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Novak has managed the regional office ------- it opened in 2021.

choices.A: already
choices.C: ever since

questions.translationJa: ノバクさんは2021年の開設以来ずっと地域事務所を管理しています。
questions.explanationJa: ever since + 過去の起点で現在までの継続を示します。

questions.prompt: This is the most efficient filing system we have ------- tested.

choices.A: yet not
choices.C: since yet

questions.translationJa: これは当社がこれまで試した中で最も効率的なファイル管理方式です。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級と ever を組み合わせて「これまでで」を表します。

questions.prompt: The meeting has ------- started, although several participants are still in the lobby.

choices.A: already
choices.C: ever

questions.translationJa: 複数の参加者がまだロビーにいますが、会議はすでに始まっています。
questions.explanationJa: 肯定文で開始済みを示す already が合います。

questions.prompt: We have not received the customs approval -------, so shipment remains on hold.

choices.A: already
choices.C: ever since

questions.translationJa: 税関承認をまだ受け取っていないため、出荷は保留中です。
questions.explanationJa: 未完の否定現在完了の文末には yet を置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence confirming an early completion.

choices.A: The technician has yet replaced the damaged sensor.
choices.B: The technician already has replace the damaged sensor.
choices.C: The technician has already replaced the damaged sensor.
choices.D: The technician has replaced yet the damaged sensor already not.

questions.translationJa: 技術者はすでに損傷したセンサーを交換しました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了では already を has の後、過去分詞の前に置けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence asking whether a document has arrived.

choices.A: Has the signed agreement yet arrived already not?
choices.B: The signed agreement has arrived yet?
choices.C: Has yet the signed agreement arrive?
choices.D: Has the signed agreement arrived yet?

questions.translationJa: 署名済み契約書はもう届きましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 疑問文では yet を通常文末に置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence stating that an action remains incomplete.

choices.A: We have not tested the backup battery yet.
choices.B: We have not yet tested already the backup battery.
choices.C: We did not tested the backup battery yet ever.
choices.D: We have yet not testing the backup battery.

questions.translationJa: バックアップ電池はまだ試験していません。
questions.explanationJa: have not + 過去分詞 + yet が未完を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence asking about prior experience.

choices.A: Have you already ever attended yet one of our online workshops?
choices.B: Have you ever attended one of our online workshops?
choices.C: Did you ever attended one of our online workshops?
choices.D: Have ever you attend one of our online workshops?

questions.translationJa: 当社のオンライン研修にこれまで参加したことがありますか。
questions.explanationJa: Have you ever + 過去分詞が経験を尋ねる正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence showing a surprising contrast.

choices.A: The fee is low, yet already the service including on-site support.
choices.B: The fee is low and yet, includes the service on-site support.
choices.C: The fee is low, and yet the service includes on-site support.
choices.D: The fee is low, and the service yet has include on-site support.

questions.translationJa: 料金は安いのに、それでも現地サポートが含まれます。
questions.explanationJa: and yet が低料金と充実したサービスの意外な対比をつなぎます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing an almost-never occurrence.

choices.A: The updated system is not hardly ever unavailable.
choices.B: The updated system hardly unavailable is ever.
choices.C: The updated system is hard ever unavailable.
choices.D: The updated system is hardly ever unavailable.

questions.translationJa: 更新後のシステムが利用不能になることはほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: be 動詞の後に hardly ever を置き、二重否定を避けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing continuous employment from a past date.

choices.A: Mr. Silva has worked here ever since he graduated.
choices.B: Mr. Silva worked here ever since he will graduate.
choices.C: Mr. Silva has ever worked here since graduated he.
choices.D: Mr. Silva has worked here since ever he graduates.

questions.translationJa: シルバさんは卒業以来ずっとここで働いています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了 + ever since + 過去形で起点からの継続を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using ever with a superlative.

choices.A: This is the largest order the branch has yet ever receive.
choices.B: This is the largest order the branch has ever received.
choices.C: This ever is the largest order the branch received already.
choices.D: This is the largest order the branch has ever receiving.

questions.translationJa: これはその支店がこれまで受けた最大の注文です。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級の範囲を the branch has ever received が限定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting that a task remains unfinished.

choices.A: The design team has already not finalized yet the label.
choices.B: The design team has not finalize the label yet.
choices.C: The design team has not finalized the label yet.
choices.D: The design team yet has not finalized already label the.

questions.translationJa: 設計チームはまだラベルを確定していません。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了否定と文末 yet の組合せが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a completed reservation.

choices.A: We have yet reserved a second conference room.
choices.B: We already have reserve a second conference room.
choices.C: We have reserved already not a second conference room yet.
choices.D: We have already reserved a second conference room.

questions.translationJa: 第2会議室はすでに予約済みです。
questions.explanationJa: 肯定現在完了で already が完了を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The invoice has already been paid.”

choices.A: Payment of the invoice was completed before now.
choices.C: No one has ever seen the invoice.
choices.D: Payment will be considered only in the future.

questions.translationJa: 請求書はすでに支払われています。
questions.explanationJa: already は現在より前に完了したことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The parts have not arrived yet.”

choices.A: The parts arrived earlier than expected.
choices.B: The parts are still expected, but they have not arrived.
choices.C: The parts will never be ordered.
choices.D: The parts have been here for years.

questions.translationJa: 部品はまだ届いていません。
questions.explanationJa: not ... yet は現時点で未完だが、今後の成立が見込まれることを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Have you ever visited the factory?”

choices.A: Did you visit the factory only today?
choices.B: Are you permanently employed at the factory?
choices.C: Has there been any time in your life when you visited the factory?
choices.D: Will you never visit the factory?

questions.translationJa: その工場をこれまで訪れたことがありますか。
questions.explanationJa: 経験疑問文の ever は「これまでのどこかの時点で」を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The device is inexpensive, and yet it is reliable.”

choices.A: Because the device is cheap, it always fails.
choices.B: The device is expensive and unreliable.
choices.C: The device has not been priced yet.
choices.D: Although the device costs little, it is dependable.

questions.translationJa: その装置は安価なのに信頼できます。
questions.explanationJa: and yet は although と同様に予想外の対比を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We hardly ever receive complaints.”

choices.A: We receive complaints on very few occasions.
choices.C: We have never handled a customer.

questions.translationJa: 苦情を受けることはほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: hardly ever は頻度がほぼゼロであることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “She has used this system ever since 2023.”

choices.A: She stopped using the system before 2023.
choices.B: Her use of the system began in 2023 and has continued.
choices.C: She will begin using it after 2023.
choices.D: She used the system only once in 2023.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は2023年以来ずっとこのシステムを使っています。
questions.explanationJa: ever since は過去の起点から現在までの継続を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “This is the best service I have ever received.”

choices.A: I have not received this service yet.
choices.B: Every service has been equally poor.
choices.C: No service in my experience has been better than this one.
choices.D: This service was the first to be canceled.

questions.translationJa: これは私がこれまで受けた中で最高のサービスです。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級 + ever が経験範囲全体との比較を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Has the meeting started yet?”

choices.A: The speaker states that the meeting ended long ago.
choices.B: The meeting is certain never to start.
choices.C: The meeting has already been canceled permanently.
choices.D: The speaker asks whether the meeting has begun by this time.

questions.translationJa: 会議はもう始まりましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 疑問文の yet は現在までに開始したかを尋ねます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The office has already closed.”

choices.A: The office closed earlier and is no longer open.
choices.B: The office remains open because closing is unfinished.
choices.C: The office will open for the first time tomorrow.
choices.D: No office has ever existed there.

questions.translationJa: 事務所はすでに閉まりました。
questions.explanationJa: already closed は閉鎖が現在より前に完了したことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “He rarely travels, and yet he has three passports.”

choices.A: He travels constantly because he has one passport.
choices.B: Despite traveling infrequently, he possesses three passports.
choices.C: He has not applied for a passport yet.
choices.D: He has traveled ever since three passports expired.

questions.translationJa: 彼はめったに旅行しないのに、パスポートを3冊持っています。
questions.explanationJa: and yet が低頻度の旅行と複数パスポートの意外な対比を示します。

questions.prompt: The tracking page shows “delivered,” and the receptionist signed for the parcel. It has ------- arrived.

choices.A: yet
choices.C: already

questions.translationJa: 追跡画面は配達済みを示し、受付担当者が受領署名しています。荷物はすでに到着しています。
questions.explanationJa: 完了の証拠がある肯定文なので already が適切です。

questions.prompt: The client is waiting for the final quotation, but the sales team is still calculating shipping costs. The quotation is not ready -------.

choices.A: already
choices.C: and yet

questions.translationJa: 顧客は最終見積もりを待っていますが、営業チームはまだ送料を計算中です。見積もりはまだ完成していません。
questions.explanationJa: 現時点で未完なので否定文末の yet を使います。

questions.prompt: A trainer wants to know whether a participant has any previous experience with the software. She asks, “Have you ------- used this program?”

choices.A: ever
choices.C: yet since

questions.translationJa: 研修担当者は参加者にソフト使用経験があるか尋ねます。「このプログラムをこれまで使ったことがありますか」。
questions.explanationJa: 経験の有無を尋ねるため ever が正解です。

questions.prompt: The branch is small, but it handled more orders than the city-center office. It is small, ------- highly productive.

choices.A: already
choices.C: ever since

questions.translationJa: 支店は小規模ですが、中心街の事務所より多くの注文を処理しました。小規模なのに生産性が高いです。
questions.explanationJa: 規模と生産性の予想外の対比を and yet で示します。

questions.prompt: Over the past five years, the backup server failed only once. It ------- becomes unavailable.

choices.A: does not hardly
choices.C: hardly ever

questions.translationJa: 過去5年間でバックアップサーバーの故障は1回だけです。利用不能になることはほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: 非常に低い頻度なので hardly ever が合います。

questions.prompt: Ms. Ito joined the customer-service team in 2022 and has remained on it continuously -------.

choices.A: already yet
choices.C: and yet

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんは2022年に顧客サービスチームへ加わり、それ以来ずっと所属しています。
questions.explanationJa: 起点が前文に示され、継続を ever since が受けます。

questions.prompt: The new terminal processes twice as many transactions as every model tested before it. It is the fastest terminal we have ------- evaluated.

choices.A: ever
choices.C: already never

questions.translationJa: 新しい端末は従来機の2倍の取引を処理します。これは当社がこれまで評価した中で最速です。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級 fastest の経験範囲を ever evaluated が示します。

questions.prompt: A customer asks whether the replacement card has been mailed. The clerk checks the system and asks the shipping team, “Has it been sent -------?”

choices.A: already not
choices.C: ever since

questions.translationJa: 顧客が交換カードの発送状況を尋ねています。担当者は「もう発送されましたか」と配送チームへ確認します。
questions.explanationJa: 現在までの完了有無を尋ねるため文末 yet が正解です。

questions.prompt: The maintenance crew completed the inspection before the building opened. By 9:00 A.M., they had ------- left the site.

choices.A: yet
choices.C: already

questions.translationJa: 保守担当は開館前に検査を終え、午前9時までにはすでに現場を離れていました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去完了でその時点より前の完了を already が示します。

questions.prompt: The current policy is detailed and has been revised several times. No department has approved it -------, so it cannot take effect.

choices.A: already
choices.C: hardly ever

questions.translationJa: 現在の方針は詳細で何度も改訂されていますが、まだどの部門も承認していないため発効できません。
questions.explanationJa: 承認が未完であることを否定文末の yet で表します。
